scope: Every governed repository keeps a fixed set of durable documents (goal and thesis, requirements with success criteria, system model with domain model and data flow carrying IDs, schema and contract pointers, decision records, derived glossary), declared in .agentic/repo.yaml; every adopted plan declares which of them it updates; plan completion and merge verify the declared update happened; a checker reports missing documents, untraced rules and stale documents. Shaped in AES canonical, wired into Company Planning's plan template, adoption and completion, piloted on two repositories, then rolled out.

fact_evidence.existing_implementation_obstacle: Nothing must be torn down; the plan adds a document contract, a plan-template section, a completion check and a checker.
fact_evidence.reproduced_failure: Survey 2026-10-10 of 36 active repositories (git ls-files by path): about 3,300 plan files, about 600 decision records, requirements documents in 2 repositories, a system model in 4 (company-planning, cybernetic_influence_v3, project-meta, vision), .aes/target.yaml in 4; Company Planning makes a PRD optional (landscape-review/SKILL.md:74) and never asks for decision records.
fact_evidence.identified_fix: The direction is set (fixed durable set, declare at adoption, verify at completion) but the document contract, ID convention and the completion hook for quick-adopted plans are undefined.
fact_evidence.concurrent_writers: check_coordination_claims.py 2026-10-10: codex company-planning:trace-review-provider-guards (writes .company-planning/history, proposals/trace-review-enforcement) and codex enforced-planning:trace-review-guards (writes scripts/complete_plan.py, the plan-completion seam this plan also touches); AES canonical claude-code commit-rule-emergency-gaps writes proposals/aes-planning/ROLLOUT.md.
fact_evidence.machine_consumed_planning_handoff: This plan is read by Brian and agents; no machine consumer ingests it.
fact_evidence.shared_contract_mutation: Extends the .agentic/repo.yaml layout contract with a durable_documents block and changes Company Planning's plan template, adoption gate and completion check, which every governed repository uses.
fact_evidence.persistent_migration: Documents are files in git; no database or data store changes.
fact_evidence.governed_registry: PROJECT_GRAPH.json and other registries are not edited.
fact_evidence.consequential_external_mutation: Pull requests to Brian-owned repositories, reversible by revert; nothing published or sent outward.
fact_evidence.answer_only: Brian, 2026-10-10: 'i approve a. i want plannign to be as rigorous as possible (within reason)' after option (a) 'I write the proposal in AES canonical and wire it into company planning's plan-finish step'.
fact_evidence.continuity_beyond_session: Contract, checker, Company Planning wiring, two pilots and rollout span several sessions.
fact_evidence.one_writer: Two Codex lanes hold write claims on the plan-completion seams in company-planning and enforced-planning.
fact_evidence.reversible: Every change is a git commit with history and a revert path.
fact_evidence.boundary_known: AES .agentic/repo.yaml (schema 0.1-pilot) declares only normative, decision and plan roots; no contract names goal, requirements or system-model documents, and quick-adopted plans have no completion event to hook.

rationale: Shared contract change touching seams other writers hold, reversible, multi-session, with the document contract still undefined: coordinated path, bounded design before any implementation, and a reconciliation obligation with the Codex trace-review lanes before touching plan completion.
